topic: Eigenvectors, Eigenvalues, and Eigenbasis: The Geometry of Linear Transformations

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The 'Stretch' Concept
lecture_lines: Linear transformations deform space like stretching rubber.
Most vectors rotate during the deformation process.
Eigenvectors are special directions remaining fixed.
animations: Draw a grid, display 'Space' in white (#FFFFFF).
Apply a stretch transformation, label 'Deformation' in light blue (#00BFFF).
Highlight vectors whose span remains unchanged in orange (#FFA500).

sections.title: Mathematical Definition: The Eigen-Equation
lecture_lines: Eigen-equation is Av equals lambda times v.
Lambda represents the scaling factor of elongation.
Det A minus lambda I equals zero.
animations: Write 'Av = λv' in center in white (#FFFFFF).
Use arrow to point from v to λv in cyan (#00FFFF).
Draw determinant calculation: det(A-λI)=0 in yellow (#FFFF00).

sections.title: Visualizing Eigenbasis
lecture_lines: Eigenvectors can form a coordinate basis.
The matrix becomes diagonal in this basis.
Complex calculations simplify to independent scaling.
animations: Draw two orthogonal vectors v1, v2 in white (#FFFFFF).
Transform to diagonal form showing scaling by λ1, λ2.
Highlight v1 and v2 with scaling factors in green (#32CD32).

sections.title: Real-world Application: Vibration & Stability
lecture_lines: Eigenvectors define the bridge's vibration shape.
animations: Animate a bridge oscillation curve in white (#FFFFFF).
Overlay eigen-mode vectors at resonance in magenta (#FF00FF).
Display 'Stable/Unstable' label as eigenvalues change in red (#FF4500).
